'''Hiitians''' or '''Hiit''' were a large avian [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Hiit]], which orbited the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Maal]].<ref name="TEA" /> Families of Hiitians lived in clan aeries.<ref name="GOR" /> They were first contacted by the [[Trianii Rangers]], after which millions of Hiitians left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to seek their fortunes in the galaxy at large. The Hiitians traded with the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Kobok/Legends|Kobok]] of [[Kobothi Space]],<ref name="GOR" /> but their relations with the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] were characterized by wary hostility after the Sector annexed Hiit in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]] had a Hiitian [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="GOR" /> Another notable Hiitian was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kar Yang]]. He was hired by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to capture the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]].<ref name="SOE:E">''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution]]''</ref> Also, at least one pirate band of Hiitians known as the [[Hiitite Ravagers]] came into conflict with the Trianii but were beaten back by the [[Trianii Rangers]].
